title: Arkret Invite Delivery Request
description: Private service-to-service request emitted by the current Realm governance Station after it commits an invite Event. The invitee Station treats included authority locations only as discovery hints.

invite_event.description: The ak.invite.create EventEnvelope being delivered. The inviter-side Station reads it from its own accepted, persisted canonical bytes; it is never rebuilt, re-signed or projected into another shape.

invite_commit.description: Realm-stream authority commit whose event_ref equals invite_event.event_id.

self_invite_dispatch_request_body.$comment: The authenticated inviter submits an accepted Event id; the Station forwards its signed Event as a notification.

account_id.description: Exact invite recipient account. Delivery is sent only to account_id.station_id.

route_assistance.description: Optional transport-only hints for recovering the same Station route. This field is outside invite_event canonical bytes and MUST NOT be copied into durable Realm state; it does not extend invite/locator TTL, change AccountId, or authorize delivery.

consent_grant_ref.description: Event ref of the invitee-issued ak.consent.grant (scope invite or any) that authorizes the inviter to send Realm/Strand invites. High-trust evidence: it is material the invitee actively issued to the inviter, equivalent in trust to a locator_ref.

consent_id.description: Optional consent typed current result id locating the holder consent typed current result, to speed up receiver verification of the active grant dot.

handle.description: Canonical handle string the inviter used as the human-readable entry point.

handle_claim.description: Signed HandleClaim status view proving that handle resolves to invite_address.account_id. The receiver MUST verify exact handle_claim.claim.subject_account_id equality, status=verified, the signed as_of/fresh_until window, null revocation fields, core/status proofs, core expiry, issuer trust, visibility/audience policy, and that handle_claim.claim.handle equals handle.

resolved_by.description: Optional stable Directory or issuer service did_core_id that supplied the handle resolution.

status.description: Generic receive status. It MUST NOT reveal whether the AccountId exists or whether policy quarantined/dropped the invite. A holder-quarantine outcome MUST be reported as deferred with no disclosed_outcome. Only a receiver policy disclosure level of outcome may add disclosed_outcome, and only with delivered|blocked.

disclosed_outcome.description: Optional graded-disclosure result, closed to delivered|blocked. Present ONLY when the subject's receive policy disclosure level for this introduction trust tier is 'outcome' and the subject did not block the issuer; omitted (opaque) otherwise. delivered: the invite reached the holder surface awaiting acceptance; blocked: rejected by block list or policy. A holder-quarantine outcome MUST NOT be disclosed: it reveals holder-private consent state (identity/consent-model.md 6.1.1) and MUST be reported as status='deferred' with no disclosed_outcome, in the same response and timing equivalence class as rate-limit silent drop, timeout drop, holder-not-found and holder policy deny.
